hypothesis: The causal near-to-far ATM implied-vol term ratio (term_ratio) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with the subsequent forward realized return skewness (third standardized moment) of the same underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the EVAL-74 term floor.
extends: EVAL-74/100 (same term_ratio signal path and sealed EVAL-74 term floor) + EVAL-109/111 (same forward realized-return-skewness target and EVAL-85 forward-window convention); distinct cell: single-asset term_ratio -> forward realized return skewness

protocol.title: Options near-to-far ATM implied-vol term ratio (term_ratio) -> forward own-asset realized return skewness predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74/100 (same term_ratio signal path and sealed EVAL-74 term floor) + EVAL-109/111 (same forward realized-return-skewness target and EVAL-85 forward-window convention); distinct cell: single-asset term_ratio -> forward realized return skewness
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-74/81/94/98/100/101; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-to-far ATM IV term ratio (e74._term_bars term_ratio), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward realized return skewness = m3 / m2**1.5 over the SAME underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k, lr[k:k+h]), transcribed verbatim from sealed EVAL-109/111
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(term_ratio_z_k, skew_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (higher near/far ATM IV ratio -> more right-skewed forward returns)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
